extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Living vs non-living — living things: grow, need food and water, breathe, reproduce, respond to stimuli, have definite lifespan (die). Non-living things: do none of these. A stone does not grow, a pencil does not breathe. Exceptions: dry seed looks lifeless but is living in dormancy — sprouts when given moisture, warmth, air. Hen egg looks non-living but contains living embryo. Living things depend on non-living things (plants grow in soil, use sunlight and water). (2) Plants and animals classification — plants: make own food, cannot move from place to place, have leaves/stems/roots. Animals: cannot make own food, can move, have different body coverings. Birds: have feathers, wings, beaks, lay eggs. Mammals: have hair, give birth to young, feed milk. Fish: have scales, fins, gills, live in water. Insects: 6 legs, 3 body parts, antennae. (3) Internal organs — 7 main organs: brain (head, control centre, thinking/movement), heart (chest, pumps blood), lungs (chest, breathing — oxygen in, used air out), stomach (abdomen, holds food, begins digestion), liver (abdomen, largest organ, makes bile, cleans blood), kidneys (abdomen, bean-shaped, filter waste, make urine), intestines (abdomen, long coiled tubes, finish digestion, push out waste). Internal = inside body, protected by bones/skin. External = outside, can see directly. Misconceptions: 'a dry seed is non-living because it does not move' (a dry seed is LIVING in a dormant state — it sprouts when given the right conditions, proving it was alive), 'non-living things can grow' (non-living things do NOT grow — a brick stays the same size, only living things grow), 'the brain is in the chest' (the brain is inside the HEAD, protected by the skull — the chest contains the heart and lungs), 'the liver and stomach are in the chest' (the liver and stomach are in the ABDOMEN, the lower part of the trunk below the chest — only the heart and lungs are in the chest), 'internal organs and external body parts are the same' (internal organs are INSIDE the body, protected by bones and skin, external body parts are on the OUTSIDE and can be seen directly). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function LivingPlantsGame), NOT export default. Export interface LivingPlantsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
